title: nf-schema example - params samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params sampleSheet

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

force.errorMessage: Barcode force parameter must be provided as an integer.

beadMergeUmiThreshold.errorMessage: The 'beadMergeUmiThreshold' parameter must be provided as an integer.

umiHamming.errorMessage: The 'umiHamming' parameter must be provided as an integer.
